{PAWN_nameDef} sat a long time with {PET_definite} before letting anyone take the body.
{PET_nameDef} is gone. {PAWN_nameDef} put the bowl away and then took it back out again.
[quiet] {PET_nameDef} died in the night, curled up in the usual spot. {PAWN_nameDef} found it in the morning and didn't eat breakfast.
[quiet] {PAWN_nameDef} keeps saying {PET_nameDef} had a good life, for out here.
[hero] {PET_nameDef} went down in front of {PAWN_nameDef}, between {PAWN_objective} and the enemy. That's where it always stood.
[hero] {PAWN_nameDef} carried {PET_definite} back from the fighting alone and wouldn't let anyone help.
[winter] {PAWN_nameDef} wanted to bury {PET_nameDef}, but the ground was frozen. {PAWN_nameDef} dug anyway.
[rain] {PAWN_nameDef} stood in the rain for a long time, at the spot where {PET_nameDef} used to wait for {PAWN_objective}.

warm.li: {PAWN_nameDef} thanked {PET_nameDef} out loud, for everything, and then asked to be left alone for a minute.
[hero] {PAWN_nameDef} says {PET_nameDef} saved {PAWN_possessive} life out there, and it's true.

blunt.li: {PAWN_nameDef} punched a wall when {PET_nameDef} died and split {PAWN_possessive} knuckles open.
[hero] "It went for them like it was twice its size," {PAWN_nameDef} said, and then stopped talking for the day.

cheerful.li: {PAWN_nameDef} told funny stories about {PET_nameDef} all evening, and laughed until {PAWN_pronoun} cried.

gloomy.li: {PAWN_nameDef} says the good ones always go first out here, and {PET_nameDef} was a good one.
[quiet] {PAWN_nameDef} buried {PET_nameDef} and said it was the only one here who never wanted anything from {PAWN_objective}.

cold.li: {PAWN_nameDef} wrote {PET_nameDef}'s death in the ledger with the date and the cause, and went back to work.

plain.li: {X_nameDef}. I learned the name from the others. I'm going to remember it for the rest of my life.
The one who did this ran when it turned. I watched {X_objective} go over the ridge and couldn't stand up to follow.
[hurt] Everything hurts, and somewhere out there {X_nameDef} is walking around on two good legs.
[night] I keep waking at every footstep outside. It's never {X_nameDef}.

gloomy.li: {X_nameDef} will come back. People like that always do.

warm.li: I'm trying not to hate {X_nameDef}. I'd settle for never seeing {X_objective} again.

cold.li: {X_nameDef} is still alive. I've made a note of the face and the name.

plain.li: They're calling it {X_nameDef} now. It got that name from what it did to me.
I can still smell it. Whatever I eat tastes like that breath.
[night] There was movement at the tree line tonight. I watched until dawn, and it didn't come again.
[winter] Tracks in the snow outside the wall this morning. Too big. Too close.

cheerful.li: I got mauled by an animal with its own name! That's a story for the grandchildren, if I live to have any.

blunt.li: That thing is going to be a rug. My rug.

gloomy.li: {X_nameDef} doesn't hate me. To it I'm just food that got away.

plain.li: {X_nameDef} is back. I saw {X_objective} before anyone else did. I always knew I would.
Same face. Same walk. {X_nameDef} came back with friends this time.
[trait:Bloodlust] {X_nameDef} came back. I sharpened everything twice.
[trait:Wimp] {X_nameDef} is here and I hid in the pantry and I'm writing this in the pantry.

gloomy.li: Of course {X_nameDef} came back. I wrote my name inside my boots, just in case.

cold.li: {X_nameDef} has returned. A second opportunity. I don't intend to waste it.

plain.li: {X_nameDef} is in a cell now. I went and looked, and {X_pronoun} was smaller than I remembered.
They brought {X_nameDef} in bleeding. I didn't help. I didn't stop anyone helping, either.
[night] I can't sleep knowing {X_nameDef} is under the same roof. I can't sleep any better when I imagine {X_objective} out there, either.

warm.li: I brought {X_nameDef} water. I don't know why. My hands did it before I decided.

blunt.li: {X_nameDef} gets bread and water. I get to watch. Seems fair.

cold.li: {X_nameDef} is contained. The council will decide what that's worth. I already have.

plain.li: It was me. {X_nameDef} looked at me at the end, and I think {X_pronoun} remembered.
{X_nameDef} is dead and I did it. I keep washing my hands. They're clean. I keep washing them.
[hurt] I'm still not healed from the first time. Doesn't matter. {X_nameDef} won't heal at all.

cheerful.li: I got {X_nameDef}! I want that on my gravestone, in big letters.

gloomy.li: {X_nameDef} is dead. I'm still the person {X_nameDef} made me. That part doesn't wash off.

cold.li: I dealt with {X_nameDef} personally. It was more satisfying than I'd predicted.

plain.li: {X_nameDef} is dead. {OTHER_nameDef} did it. I should thank {OTHER_objective}. I will, when I can say it without shaking.
They told me {X_nameDef} is dead and I asked them to say it again, slower.

warm.li: {OTHER_nameDef} ended it for me. I'm cooking {OTHER_objective} dinner every night this week whether {OTHER_pronoun} likes it or not.

blunt.li: Wanted to do it myself. Dead is dead, though.

gloomy.li: {X_nameDef} is dead and I feel exactly the same. I was told I'd feel different.

plain.li: The one I brought down today was {X_nameDef}, the one who hurt {VICTIM}. I didn't know until after. Glad it was me.
{VICTIM} hugged me today, hard, and didn't say anything.

blunt.li: Killed {X_nameDef}. Apparently that's a big deal. It felt like any other fight.

cheerful.li: {VICTIM} says I'm a hero! Then {VICTIM} cried all over my shirt, the good kind of crying.

cold.li: {X_nameDef} is removed. {VICTIM} is grateful. Gratitude is a useful currency.

plain.li: {PET_nameDef} is gone. I keep saving the scraps from my plate anyway.
Buried {PET_nameDef} today. Somebody scratched the name into a board for the grave. I didn't ask them to.
[night] The room is too quiet. I didn't know an animal could breathe that loudly until it stopped.
[child] They say {PET_nameDef} went to sleep and won't wake up. I'm not stupid. I know what dead is.

warm.li: Thank you, {PET_nameDef}, for waiting at the door every single day.

gloomy.li: {PET_nameDef} was the only one here who never looked at me like I'd done something wrong.

cold.li: {PET_nameDef} has died. I won't be taking on another animal.

plain.li: When they came at me, {PET_nameDef} came at them. I've never seen it move like that.
{PET_nameDef} gets the best cut of meat tonight, and every night this week.
[hurt] I'm patched up and sore, and {PET_nameDef} won't leave my side. Neither of us is complaining.

cheerful.li: {PET_nameDef} is a warrior! I'm making it a tiny helmet.

blunt.li: {PET_nameDef} fought better than most of the people here. I said so at dinner.

gloomy.li: {PET_nameDef} would die for me. I don't know what I've done to earn that.

cold.li: {PET_nameDef} proved a reliable defensive asset. I'll see that it's fed well.
